text:
jen_support: Heads-up — AcmeInc opened an escalation. Their month-end invoice (inv_2024_03_31) is ~1,220,345 tokens but their dashboard shows ~812,400 for the same period. They say plan tier on invoice is ‘Enterprise’ but account is on ‘Pro’ for whole month.

mike_billing: Can you paste acct id + invoice link?

jen_support: acct: acct_0acme123, invoice: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/inv_2024_03_31 (attached in ticket). Customer insists they didn't upgrade. They sent screenshot of dashboard and exported CSV.

luke_eng: Ack. Two quick checks: 1) did we switch metering backfill/repipeline around cutoff? 2) any duped ingestion events (request_id reuse)?

priya_sre: We rolled metering v2 on 03-28; there was a short backfill job that deduped by event_id but not request_id. Could be duplicates if clients retried with same request_id.

mike_billing: If tokens were double-counted we should issue credit. But need authoritative raw count before action.

jen_support: Customer provided sample rows (CSV) — looks like many entries with same request_id at different timestamps. I'll attach snippet.

jen_support: ```csv
request_id,timestamp,tokens,route
r123,2024-03-30T23:59:59Z,1200,generate
r123,2024-03-31T00:00:01Z,1200,generate
r124,2024-03-15T12:00:00Z,500,embed
``` 

luke_eng: That CSV lines up with the suspicion. We should run a de-dupe query against raw events. Use this:

luke_eng: ```sql
-- sum tokens deduped by request_id
SELECT sum(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM (
  SELECT request_id, max(tokens) as tokens
  FROM usage_events_raw
  WHERE account_id = 'acct_0acme123' AND timestamp >= '2024-03-01' AND timestamp < '2024-04-01'
  GROUP BY request_id
) t;
```

priya_sre: Also check timezone cutoff: dashboard uses UTC-0 daily buckets but billing cutoff was accidentally using account's timezone for March run (we changed config on 03-27). That could move some events across month boundary.

mike_billing: Good catch — if cutoff mismatch moved 10k tokens into next invoice that explains some variance but not +400k. Need both de-dupe + cutoff alignment analysis.

usage-bot: Daily usage export for acct_0acme123: https://usage-exports.redwood.ai/exports/acct_0acme123/2024-03.csv.gz

jen_support: Running luke's SQL now on staging exports, will paste results.

jen_support: Quick run (staging mirror): deduped total = 818,712 tokens for March.

mike_billing: That matches the dashboard (812k approx). So invoice extra ~401k likely from duplicates + billing pipeline double-aggregation. Any idea where duplicate aggregation could happen?

luke_eng: Two places: metering ingestion and billing aggregator. If backfill job reprocessing flagged events but billing aggregator didn't dedupe on event_id/request_id, they'd be counted twice. I'll grep aggregator logs for reprocess markers around 2024-03-28..30.

luke_eng: ```bash
# check for backfill marker
grep -R "backfill_reprocess" /var/log/redwood/billing/2024-03-2*
```

luke_eng: Found multiple reprocess batches with overlapping time windows.

priya_sre: We also muted a TTL on the Kafka dedupe store for a day (03-29) to speed backfill. That could allow duplicates to survive.

mike_billing: Proposed remediation:
- Recompute authoritative tokens using dedup-by-request_id (as Luke ran) for acct_0acme123.
- Create credit for overcharged amount on inv_2024_03_31.
- Patch billing aggregator to dedupe by request_id AND event_id and re-run aggregation for March window.
- Add a one-off script to reconcile other accounts that had high retry rates during 03-27..03-30.

jen_support: Customer asked for timeline and credit ETA. Can we commit to a next-action timeline?

luke_eng: I can run full deduped aggregation in ~2h for that account once finance approves. It’ll produce final token count + a diff file. Will also add a safety check to prevent double-insert.

mike_billing: Finance needs the diff in CSV with fields: account_id, invoice_id, original_tokens, deduped_tokens, credit_tokens, credit_amount_usd.

jen_support: I'll tell customer we have root cause (backfill + dedupe TTL) and that we’ll issue a credit once finance approves. ETA 4 business hours for initial recon.

priya_sre: I'll add a postmortem stub and schedule downtime-free fix: increase dedupe window, and add alert for >5% invoice vs dashboard delta during month-end runs.

usage-bot: Created ticket: BS-2024-3118 (billing sync double-count) — linked to incident channel.

luke_eng: One more note — some tenants had mid-month plan changes. If a prorate step ran twice (old plan + new plan) charges could be duplicated. For acct_0acme123 they stayed on Pro whole month, so not applicable here but check for others.

mike_billing: Thanks team. Jen — keep the customer updated. Post credit once finance confirms amount. :thumbsup:

jen_support: Will do. Attaching logs and CSVs to ticket now. :white_check_mark:

priya_sre: filing retro action items.

mike_billing: Closing loop when finance posts credit entry.

jen_support: Thanks all.
